body.name: fixed_k_handle
body.def: \(\mathsf H_{\rm tr}\) searches, for each fixed \(K\) and \(a\in[a_L,a_U]\), for a uniformly positive regular boundary law \(P_{0,a}\) with \(d(P_{0,a})=0\) and a legal transverse parametric path \(P_{t,a}\in\mathcal P_K(a)\) satisfying \(d(P_{t,a})\asymp |t|\) and \(D_{\rm KL}(P_{t,a}\|P_{0,a})\le C t^2\) with constants uniform in \(a\)
